name: Charles Uderman
bio: Charles Uderman was nominated by acclamation for constable at the October 1886 citizens' nominating convention. He was listed among the successful candidates in November 1886.

moments.label: Listed among the successful constable candidates

mentions: …, A. T. Packard, C. F. Ellison, Howard Eaton. For Constables. Peter Pelissier, William Jones, Samuel Whitney, Charles Uderman. For County Seat. Medora.

…were nominated by acclamation as justices of the peace.  Peter Pelissier, Wm. Jones, Samuel Whitney and Chas. Uderman were nominated by acclamation as constables.  On motion of Willis Eaton, Medora was named as county seat.  Adjourned.
…D, F. D. FOSTER, C. F. ELLISON, HOWARD EATON. For Constables. PETER PELISSIER, WILLIAM JONES, SAMUEL WHITNEY, CHARLES UDERMAN. For County Seat. MEDORA.
